RenameThread.note: Open dialog with header/description, a real Label + Input pair and a ghost/primary footer. Panel uses the canonical bg-background surface, rounded-xl border and shadow-modal; close glyph top-right.

AddRepository.note: Richer body: two bordered repo rows with GitBranch icons and success/neutral Badges. Nothing collapses, footer sits below the body with the correct pt-4 gap.

WithTriggerBehind.note: DialogTrigger renders behind the open content, so the trigger→content composition is visible in one frame. Destructive footer action varies the axis.

NoCloseButton.note: showCloseButton={false} — the top-right glyph is gone and the single primary action carries the dialog. Reads clearly different from the other three cells.
